info.name: Open API, powered by Propertyware Accounting Bills API

params.name: offset
params.description: `offset` indicates the position of the first record to return. The offset is zero-based and the default is 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: `limit` indicates the maximum number of results to be returned in the response. `limit` can range between 1 and 500 and the default is 100.

params.name: lastModifiedDateTimeStart
params.description: Filters results to any item modified on or after the date time specified.

params.name: lastModifiedDateTimeEnd
params.description: Filters results to any item modified on or prior to the date time specified.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Indicates the field(s) and direction to sort the results in the response.

params.name: portfolioID
params.description: Filters results to bills associated with a specific portfolio.

params.name: vendorID
params.description: Filters results to bills associated with a specific vendor.

params.name: workOrderID
params.description: Filters results to bills associated with a specific work order.

params.name: markupGLAccountID
params.description: Filters results to bills associated with a specific markup general ledger account.

params.name: paid
params.description: Filters results by the bill's paid status. If no status is specified, bills with any status will be returned.

params.name: billDateStart
params.description: Filters results to any bill with a billing date on or after to the date specified.

params.name: billDateEnd
params.description: Filters results to any bill with a billing date on or prior to the date specified.

params.name: dueDateStart
params.description: Filters results to any bill with a due date on or after to the date specified.

params.name: dueDateEnd
params.description: Filters results to any bill with a due date on or prior to the date specified.
